description: Source file implementing RTIO (Real-Time Input/Output) handlers and verification functions for Zephyr RTOS, including validation of SQE operations, buffer management, and syscall wrappers.

methods.name: rtio_vrfy_sqe
methods.description: Validates an RTIO SQE (Submission Queue Entry) based on operation type and memory accessibility.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_release_buffer
methods.description: Wrapper for releasing RTIO buffer with syscall object validation.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_cqe_get_mempool_buffer
methods.description: Wrapper for retrieving mempool buffer from RTIO completion queue entry with syscall validation.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_sqe_cancel
methods.description: Wrapper for canceling an RTIO SQE.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_sqe_copy_in_get_handles
methods.description: Copies and verifies an array of SQEs, acquiring handles and validating each.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_cqe_copy_out
methods.description: Copies out completion queue entries with validation.

methods.name: z_vrfy_rtio_submit
methods.description: Submits RTIO work with validation of the RTIO object and semaphore if configured.
